registers.name: dvp_version
registers.description: DVP controller version register. Identifies the major and minor software interface revision.

fields.name: major
fields.description:
Major IP version number. Software reads this value to select a compatible driver.

Usage: Read during initialization; software never writes this field.

Values:
0x1 major version 1 (reset value).

Unit: none

Limits: 16-bit unsigned version number.

fields.name: minor
fields.description:
Minor IP version number. Software reads this value to identify compatible interface additions.

Usage: Read with the major version during initialization; software never writes this field.

Values:
0x0 minor version 0 (reset value).

Unit: none

Limits: 16-bit unsigned version number.

registers.name: dvp_ctrl
registers.description: DVP controller control register. Enables or disables qualified sensor sample capture.

fields.name: capture_en
fields.description:
Capture enable bit. Allows qualified DVP samples to enter the asynchronous sample FIFO.

Usage: Program after the sensor profile, watermark and timeout are configured; clear it to stop new capture.

Values:
0x0 capture disabled (reset value);
0x1 capture enabled.

Unit: none

Limits: One-bit value.

registers.name: dvp_wmark
registers.description: DVP FIFO watermark register. Selects the occupancy that requests a DMA service batch.

fields.name: level
fields.description:
FIFO watermark level. Raises the DMA batch request when read-side occupancy reaches this sample count.

Usage: Program before enabling capture; zero disables DMA requests; use a value no greater than PARA_FIFO_DEPTH.

Values:
0x0 DMA request disabled (reset value);
0x1 to 0xFFFFFFFF request at or above the programmed occupancy, subject to FIFO depth.

Unit: sample entries

Limits: Zero disables requests; valid nonzero values are 1 through PARA_FIFO_DEPTH; values greater than the physical depth are unreachable thresholds and leave the request deasserted.

registers.name: dvp_timeout
registers.description: DVP FIFO timeout register. Bounds APB wait cycles for reads of an empty FIFO-data endpoint.

fields.name: cycles
fields.description:
FIFO-empty timeout. Limits the APB access cycles an empty FIFO-data read may wait before returning PSLVERR.

Usage: Program before DMA reads; zero gives an immediate error in the first access cycle when FIFO is empty; data available on the terminal decision cycle wins.

Values:
0x0 immediate empty-read timeout (reset value);
0x1 to 0xFFFFFFFF wait the programmed number of APB access cycles.

Unit: APB clock cycles

Limits: 32-bit unsigned count; applies only while a FIFO-data read is active and the FIFO is empty.

registers.name: dvp_fifo_sts
registers.description: DVP FIFO status register. Reports capture activity, FIFO flags and sticky overflow.

fields.name: active
fields.description:
Capture active status. Reports the DVP-domain state after the capture enable request is synchronized.

Usage: Read at any time to determine whether the capture logic is active.

Values:
0x0 inactive (reset value);
0x1 active.

Unit: none

Limits: One-bit synchronized status; it may lag the APB control write by CDC latency.

fields.name: empty
fields.description:
FIFO empty status. Reports that no sample is available at the APB read side.

Usage: Read before or after DMA service; a value of one means FIFO_DATA reads will wait or time out.

Values:
0x0 not empty;
0x1 empty (reset value after coordinated FIFO reset).

Unit: none

Limits: Read-side FIFO flag; valid after both FIFO domains report reset initialization.

fields.name: full
fields.description:
FIFO full status. Reports that the sensor-side FIFO cannot accept another sample.

Usage: Read while capture is active to monitor backpressure risk; the sensor itself cannot be stalled.

Values:
0x0 not full (reset value);
0x1 full.

Unit: none

Limits: Write-side FIFO flag synchronized to the APB domain; subject to CDC latency.

fields.name: ovf
fields.description:
FIFO overflow event. Sticky flag records a qualified sample rejected because the FIFO was full.

Usage: Read after capture; write one to clear after software records or handles the sample loss; a new hardware event wins over a simultaneous clear.

Values:
0x0 no recorded overflow (reset value);
0x1 overflow recorded.

Unit: none

Limits: One-bit sticky status; hardware sets it from the synchronized DVP-domain overflow event.

registers.name: dvp_fifo_level
registers.description: DVP FIFO level register. Reports the APB read-side occupancy estimate in sample entries.

fields.name: count
fields.description:
FIFO occupancy estimate. Reports the number of sample entries visible at the APB read side.

Usage: Read before selecting a DMA batch size or while diagnosing FIFO service; it is a read-only live estimate.

Values:
0x0 no samples available (reset value);
0x1 to 0xFFFFFFFF current read-side occupancy estimate.

Unit: sample entries

Limits: Value ranges from zero through PARA_FIFO_DEPTH and can lag sensor-side writes by CDC synchronization latency.
